answer: I trust a proof that lives outside the applicant's own hands, and Clockmaker pendulum mark struck within the dial shop is that proof: each pendulum is a timing record the assay inspector witnessed. A real proof settles maker, moment and hand in a single breath. The check happens before any reward is counted, never after the coins are gone. Every basalt has a workshop behind it, every voyage a ledger, every comet a year — and the farm has stood in none of those places.
